boundary: A capability exists only when the exact source/tool is available in this operator run and the connected principal has permission. This matrix documents routing rules; it does not grant permissions.

capabilities.description: Read metadata and artifacts from an explicitly scoped GitHub repository.
capabilities.available_when: An exact GitHub read action exists and the connected principal can access the named repository/resource.
limitations: A read from one repository does not imply access to other repositories/services.
An empty API page only supports a scoped statement about that query.

capabilities.description: Write scoped repository artifacts for a user-directed task.
capabilities.available_when: The exact write tool and permission exist, and the task names the repository and bounded outcome.
write_operations: create one commit containing related changes via blobs/tree/commit/ref compare-and-swap
create a branch or pull request when explicitly in scope
limitations: Main is currently unprotected.
Use expected-head compare-and-swap; never force-push to avoid conflicts.
Verify resulting commit and CI.

capabilities.description: Perform protected or consequential GitHub operations.
capabilities.available_when: The exact privileged action exists and explicit approval covers the resource/effect.
write_operations: publish release or merge consequential code
limitations: Tool availability is not approval.
A context cannot authorize itself.
Block when permission or approval evidence is missing.

capabilities.description: Read a named service record through an exact advertised connector action.
capabilities.available_when: The connection is active, exact action/schema is discoverable, and the principal has resource access.
read_operations: resolve exact connector action/schema for this task
limitations: No wildcard access to all connectors or all data.
Never guess operation names, resource IDs, or arguments.
Record source revision/time and limitations.

capabilities.description: Write or trigger an operation in a named connected service.
capabilities.available_when: An exact write action/schema exists and policy/permission allows the scoped effect.
write_operations: resolve exact operation from the current tool contract; do not wildcard
limitations: Escalate consequence-class C actions to explicit per-action authorization.
Connector-specific confirmation requirements still apply.
Never store credentials in context state.

capabilities.description: Read scoped information from a user-provided file.
capabilities.available_when: The artifact is attached or available through a supported file connector and access is permitted.
limitations: Preserve source locator.
Do not copy secrets or unnecessary protected data.

capabilities.description: Read public web sources through an actually available web/fetch tool.
capabilities.available_when: The URL/query is supported and accessible to the current tool.
limitations: Some pages/authenticated files are inaccessible.
Failed fetches are recorded as inaccessible, not treated as empty evidence.

capabilities.description: Normalize explicit user requirements or decisions into durable input records.
capabilities.available_when: The user directly supplied or explicitly asked to capture the requirement.
write_operations: commit minimal normalized requirement record when in task scope
limitations: Do not make the full transcript canonical by default.
Separate explicit requirements from inference.
